jobs.prompt: A 1600x900 hand-painted game background illustration in the exact style of the reference: a painterly storybook interior with soft volumetric light, restrained saturation and confident brushwork. No characters, no creatures, no people, no UI, no text, no numbers, no borders. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: the centre and lower-middle of the frame must be an OPEN, uncluttered floor with clear standing room - party members and props are drawn on top of it at runtime. Put the interesting shapes along the walls, the upper half and the edges. The floor should read as a continuous walkable surface receding into the frame. Light comes from one or two warm practical sources so the empty floor still has something to catch. The place is a flooded cave beneath a well-garden. Still black water fills the lower left, and a broad wet stone shelf runs through the centre as the walkable floor - damp, reflective, but clearly standable. Rope-and-plank walkways and hanging buckets line the walls; slow drips ring outward on the water. Palette: deep navy and midnight indigo water, wet grey-green stone, one warm lantern glow reflected in the pool.
